text:
```yaml
name: MBridge Dependencies Sync

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  sync-dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v6

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v6
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Upgrade GitHub Actions dependencies
      run: |
        sed -i 's|actions/checkout@.*|actions/checkout@v6|' .github/workflows/*.yml
        sed -i 's|actions/upload-artifact@.*|actions/upload-artifact@v6|' .github/workflows/*.yml
        sed -i 's|actions/download-artifact@.*|actions/download-artifact@v7|' .github/workflows/*.yml
        sed -i 's|actions/github-script@.*|actions/github-script@v8|' .github/workflows/*.yml
        sed -i 's|actions/setup-python@.*|actions/setup-python@v6|' .github/workflows/*.yml

    - name: Commit and push changes
      run: |
        git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
        git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
        git add .github/workflows/*.yml
        git commit -m "Upgrade GitHub Actions for Node.js 24 compatibility"
        git push origin main
```
